## Bug Summary

- **App Version & Build**: (e.g., `v6.0.0-SM-R860 · Build 6`)
- **Configured AI Provider**: (`Google Gemini` / `OpenAI` / `Custom Endpoint` / `None`)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to `'...'`
2. Tap on `'...'`
3. Speak or enter `'...'`
4. Observe error

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened (include any status banner message or Logcat output, making sure to redact any personal API keys).
